entities.name: Ivo Lukačovič
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ivo Lukačovič is a Czech entrepreneur, founder and chairman of Seznam.cz, an Internet portal in the Czech Republic. According to Forbes magazine, he is the 11th richest person in the Czech Republic, with assets of around $1.3 billion.
